blocks.zh: 6. Microbiological Air and Surface Monitoring | 微生物空氣與表面監測
blocks.en: 6. Microbiological Air and Surface Monitoring

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EM 的「三個為什麼」
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Three Whys" of EM

blocks.zh: 環境監測 (Environmental Monitoring, EM) 的三大目的：
blocks.en: The three main purposes of Environmental Monitoring (EM):

blocks.zh: 趨勢識別：單次結果不一定有意義，但連續數據揭示系統性問題（如某個工作台持續偏高）
blocks.en: Trend identification: a single result is not necessarily meaningful, but continuous data reveals systemic problems (such as one workbench that is consistently high)

blocks.zh: 污染路徑識別：哪個位置的菌落計數總是偏高？可能是清潔死角或人流問題
blocks.en: Identifying contamination pathways: which location always has high colony counts? It may be a cleaning blind spot or a personnel-flow problem

blocks.zh: 矯正行動觸發：超過 Action Level 時必須調查，而非忽略
blocks.en: Triggering corrective action: when an action level is exceeded, an investigation must be carried out, not ignored

blocks.zh: EM 行動水準完整對照表
blocks.en: Complete EM Action Level Reference Table

blocks.zh:
空氣採樣 (cfu/m³):
  ISO Class 5 (PEC)     → Action Level: >1
  ISO Class 7 (緩衝室)  → Action Level: >10
  ISO Class 8 (前室)    → Action Level: >100

表面採樣 (cfu/媒體裝置):
  ISO Class 5 (PEC)     → Action Level: >3
  ISO Class 7 (緩衝室)  → Action Level: >5
  ISO Class 8 (前室)    → Action Level: >50

採樣頻率：
  Cat 1/2 空氣採樣：每 6 個月
  Cat 3 空氣採樣：每月（調配前30天內）
  Cat 1/2 表面採樣：每月
  Cat 3 表面採樣：每週 + 每批次後
blocks.en:
Air sampling (cfu/m³):
  ISO Class 5 (PEC)         → Action Level: >1
  ISO Class 7 (buffer room) → Action Level: >10
  ISO Class 8 (anteroom)    → Action Level: >100

Surface sampling (cfu/media device):
  ISO Class 5 (PEC)         → Action Level: >3
  ISO Class 7 (buffer room) → Action Level: >5
  ISO Class 8 (anteroom)    → Action Level: >50

Sampling frequency:
  Cat 1/2 air sampling: every 6 months
  Cat 3 air sampling: monthly (within 30 days before compounding)
  Cat 1/2 surface sampling: monthly
  Cat 3 surface sampling: weekly + after each batch

blocks.zh: 重點提示：表面採樣的時機選擇
blocks.en: Key Point: Choosing the Timing of Surface Sampling

blocks.zh: 表面採樣必須在調配結束後、清潔前進行。這個時機設計得非常聰明：它反映的是調配過程中累積的真實污染程度，而非清潔後的結果。
blocks.en: Surface sampling must be performed after compounding is finished and before cleaning. This timing is cleverly designed: it reflects the true level of contamination accumulated during compounding, rather than the result after cleaning.

blocks.zh: 若在清潔後採樣，結果會人為偏低，無法真實評估調配過程中的污染狀態。
blocks.en: If sampling is done after cleaning, the results will be artificially low and cannot truly assess the contamination status during compounding.

blocks.zh: 比喻：像在廚房打烊前檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Checking the Kitchen Before Closing

blocks.zh: 想像一個餐廳的衛生檢查：最好的時間是晚餐高峰後、清潔前。此時砧板、爐台、台面上的污染程度最能反映廚房在工作時的實際衛生狀況。
blocks.en: Imagine a hygiene inspection at a restaurant: the best time is after the dinner rush and before cleaning. At that point the contamination on cutting boards, stovetops and countertops best reflects the kitchen's actual hygiene while it is working.

blocks.zh: 若等到清潔後才檢查，已看不到真實的污染——只能看到清潔效果。無菌調配環境的表面採樣邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: If you wait until after cleaning to inspect, you can no longer see the real contamination, only the effect of the cleaning. The logic of surface sampling in a sterile compounding environment is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Category 3 的每週表面採樣成本
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Cost of Weekly Surface Sampling for Category 3

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 要求每週表面採樣——這相當於 Category 1/2 月頻率的四倍。加上每批次後的 PEC 採樣，如果設施每週調配5批次 Category 3 CSP，等於每週至少6次表面採樣記錄。
blocks.en: Category 3 CSPs require weekly surface sampling, which is four times the monthly frequency for Category 1/2. Adding PEC sampling after each batch, if a facility compounds 5 batches of Category 3 CSPs per week, that amounts to at least 6 surface sampling records per week.

blocks.zh: 這是 Category 3 運作成本顯著高於 Category 2 的直接原因之一，必須在定價中充分反映。
blocks.en: This is one of the direct reasons why Category 3 operating costs are significantly higher than Category 2, and it must be fully reflected in pricing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: ISO Class 5 PEC 的空氣採樣結果為 2 cfu/m³，是否需要調查？需要採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: The air sampling result for an ISO Class 5 PEC is 2 cfu/m³. Does it need to be investigated? What steps should be taken?

blocks.zh: 某設施剛更換了消毒劑品牌。根據 6.1 的要求，是否需要進行額外的環境採樣？
blocks.en: A facility has just changed its disinfectant brand. Under the requirements of 6.1, is additional environmental sampling required?

blocks.zh: Category 3 緩衝室的表面採樣結果為 8 cfu（ISO Class 7 動作水準為 >5）。需要做微生物鑑定嗎？依據為何？
blocks.en: The surface sampling result in a Category 3 buffer room is 8 cfu (the ISO Class 7 action level is >5). Is microbial identification required? What is the basis?

blocks.zh: 7. Cleaning, Disinfecting, and Applying Sporicidal Disinfectants | 清潔、消毒與殺孢子劑
blocks.en: 7. Cleaning, Disinfecting, and Applying Sporicidal Disinfectants

blocks.zh: 核心概念：清潔 → 消毒 → 殺孢子 的三步邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three-Step Logic of Cleaning → Disinfecting → Sporicidal

blocks.zh: 這三個步驟不可互換，有嚴格的邏輯順序：
blocks.en: These three steps are not interchangeable; they follow a strict logical order:

blocks.zh: 清潔 (Cleaning)：用清潔劑物理去除有機物和殘留藥物。有機物存在會降低消毒劑效果。
blocks.en: Cleaning: uses a cleaning agent to physically remove organic matter and drug residues. The presence of organic matter reduces the effectiveness of disinfectants.

blocks.zh: 消毒 (Disinfecting)：用 EPA 認可消毒劑殺滅細菌、黴菌、病毒。
blocks.en: Disinfecting: uses an EPA-registered disinfectant to kill bacteria, molds and viruses.

blocks.zh: 殺孢子 (Sporicidal)：殺滅細菌芽孢（最具抵抗力的微生物形態）。
blocks.en: Sporicidal: kills bacterial spores (the most resistant form of microorganism).

blocks.zh: 若跳過清潔直接消毒，有機污物會保護微生物免受消毒劑的殺滅。
blocks.en: If cleaning is skipped and disinfection is applied directly, organic soil will protect microorganisms from being killed by the disinfectant.

blocks.zh: 比喻：三步驟如同餐廳餐具洗滌
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three Steps Are Like Washing Restaurant Tableware

blocks.zh: 第一步：用清潔劑去除食物殘留（清潔）。第二步：放入洗碗機高溫殺菌（消毒）。第三步（對手術器械）：用高壓蒸汽滅菌芽孢（殺孢子）。
blocks.en: Step 1: remove food residue with detergent (cleaning). Step 2: put it in a high-temperature dishwasher to sanitize (disinfecting). Step 3 (for surgical instruments): sterilize spores with high-pressure steam (sporicidal).

blocks.zh: 若直接跳到第二步而不清潔，食物殘留就是微生物的保護盾。同樣地，無菌調配室的表面必須先清潔，再消毒，再殺孢子。
blocks.en: If you jump straight to step 2 without cleaning, the food residue acts as a shield for microorganisms. Likewise, surfaces in a sterile compounding room must first be cleaned, then disinfected, then treated with a sporicidal agent.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：殺孢子劑頻率的 Category 差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Category Differences in Sporicidal Frequency

blocks.zh: PEC 內部的殺孢子劑施用頻率：
blocks.en: Frequency of sporicidal application inside the PEC:

blocks.zh: Category 1/2：每月一次
blocks.en: Category 1/2: once a month

blocks.zh: Category 3：每週一次
blocks.en: Category 3: once a week

blocks.zh: 這個差距（4倍）對設施的清潔成本和排程影響顯著。殺孢子劑通常比普通消毒劑更具腐蝕性，接觸時間更長（有時需要 10+ 分鐘），會增加設備磨損和調配停機時間。
blocks.en: This difference (4 times) has a significant impact on the facility's cleaning costs and scheduling. Sporicidal agents are usually more corrosive than ordinary disinfectants and have longer contact times (sometimes 10+ minutes), which increases equipment wear and compounding downtime.

blocks.zh: PEC 內部清潔的 70% IPA 規則
blocks.en: The 70% IPA Rule for Cleaning Inside the PEC

blocks.zh:
調配開始前：
  → 在清潔消毒後施用 70% IPA（去除殘留）
  → 立即在調配前再次施用 70% IPA

調配過程中：
  → 若調配 ≤ 30 分鐘：每 30 分鐘施用一次
  → 若調配 > 30 分鐘：不中斷，結束後立即消毒

重要：70% IPA 必須是無菌的（Sterile 70% IPA）
      必須讓表面完全乾燥後才開始調配
blocks.en:
Before compounding begins:
  → Apply 70% IPA after cleaning and disinfecting (to remove residues)
  → Apply 70% IPA again immediately before compounding

During compounding:
  → If compounding ≤ 30 minutes: apply once every 30 minutes
  → If compounding > 30 minutes: do not interrupt; disinfect immediately after finishing

Important: the 70% IPA must be sterile (Sterile 70% IPA)
           the surface must dry completely before compounding starts

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「接觸時間」是關鍵
blocks.en: Key Point: "Contact Time" Is the Key

blocks.zh: 消毒劑和殺孢子劑都有「最短接觸時間 (minimum contact time/dwell time)」的要求。噴上去立刻擦掉等於沒消毒。必須讓消毒劑在表面保持足夠時間，讓活性成分充分作用。
blocks.en: Both disinfectants and sporicidal agents have a "minimum contact time (dwell time)" requirement. Spraying and immediately wiping it off is the same as not disinfecting. The disinfectant must remain on the surface long enough for the active ingredient to work fully.

blocks.zh: SOP 中必須明確規定每種消毒劑的接觸時間，且人員必須知道並遵守。
blocks.en: The SOP must clearly specify the contact time for each disinfectant, and personnel must know and follow it.

blocks.zh: 調配人員在 LAFW 工作台上先噴 70% IPA，立刻擦乾，然後開始調配。這是否符合要求？
blocks.en: A compounder sprays 70% IPA on the LAFW workbench, wipes it dry immediately, and then starts compounding. Does this meet the requirements?

blocks.zh: 某設施使用 EPA 認可的一步式消毒清潔劑（one-step disinfectant cleaner）。是否還需要單獨的清潔步驟？
blocks.en: A facility uses an EPA-registered one-step disinfectant cleaner. Is a separate cleaning step still required?

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 的 PEC 殺孢子劑必須施用多少頻率？若此緩衝室同時也調配 Category 2，頻率應為何？
blocks.en: At what frequency must the sporicidal agent be applied in the PEC for Category 3 CSPs? If this buffer room also compounds Category 2, what should the frequency be?

blocks.zh: 8–9. Introducing Items into SEC/PEC & Equipment | 物品引入與設備管理
blocks.en: 8–9. Introducing Items into SEC/PEC & Equipment

blocks.zh: 核心概念：物品進入分類區的「逐級消毒」原則
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Step-by-Step Disinfection" Principle for Items Entering Classified Areas

blocks.zh: 物品從外部進入無菌調配環境需要「逐級升級」消毒處理：
blocks.en: Items moving from the outside into the sterile compounding environment need "escalating" disinfection at each step:

blocks.zh: 進入 SEC 前室（clean side）：EPA 消毒劑 / 殺孢子劑 / 70% IPA（任選其一，保持接觸時間）
blocks.en: Entering the SEC anteroom (clean side): EPA-registered disinfectant / sporicidal agent / 70% IPA (any one of them, maintaining the contact time)

blocks.zh: 進入 PEC：無菌 70% IPA（更嚴格——必須是無菌等級）
blocks.en: Entering the PEC: sterile 70% IPA (stricter: it must be sterile grade)

blocks.zh: PEC 內關鍵部位：仍需擦拭（如針劑瓶口、安瓿頸部）
blocks.en: Critical sites inside the PEC: still need to be wiped (such as vial necks and ampule necks)

blocks.zh: 每次進階一層，都需要更嚴格的處理，因為越接近 CSP，污染影響越直接。
blocks.en: Each step inward requires stricter treatment, because the closer to the CSP, the more direct the effect of contamination.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的消毒分區
blocks.en: Analogy: Disinfection Zones in an Operating Room

blocks.zh: 手術器械從倉庫到手術台的過程：外包裝擦拭 → 通過清潔室 → 開包進入無菌台 → 外科醫師直接操作。每個環節的潔淨要求都更嚴格。
blocks.en: The path of a surgical instrument from storeroom to operating table: wipe the outer packaging → pass through the clean room → open the package onto the sterile field → the surgeon handles it directly. The cleanliness requirement is stricter at every stage.

blocks.zh: 無菌調配的物品管理邏輯完全相同——從外到內，每一層都要更嚴格。
blocks.en: The logic of item management in sterile compounding is exactly the same: from the outside in, every layer must be stricter.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Critical Site 的定義與重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Definition and Importance of a Critical Site

blocks.zh: Critical Site (關鍵部位)：任何直接接觸空氣、可能被觸碰的開口或流路表面，包括：
blocks.en: Critical Site: Any opening or fluid pathway surface that is directly exposed to air and may be touched, including:

blocks.zh: 注射瓶塞（vial stoppers）
blocks.en: vial stoppers

blocks.zh: 安瓿頸部（ampule necks）
blocks.en: ampule necks

blocks.zh: 靜脈袋注射隔膜（IV bag septums）
blocks.en: IV bag septums

blocks.zh: 70% IPA 必須完全乾燥後才能穿刺。濕的 IPA 可能影響藥品，也可能使玻璃滑手導致安全事故。
blocks.en: 70% IPA must dry completely before puncturing. Wet IPA may affect the drug, and may also make glass slippery and cause a safety incident.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：1年內使用期限的原料管理
blocks.en: Practical Application: Managing Components with a 1-Year Use Limit

blocks.zh: 對於沒有廠商效期的 API 和輔料，必須在收貨時標記收貨日期，並指定不超過1年的保存期限。這在院外調配藥局中尤為重要，因為有些散裝原料可能缺乏明確效期。
blocks.en: For APIs and excipients that have no manufacturer expiration date, the date of receipt must be marked on receipt and a storage period of no more than 1 year assigned. This is especially important in compounding pharmacies outside hospitals, because some bulk materials may lack a clear expiration date.

blocks.zh: SOP 必須包含這一規定，並建立追蹤系統（如 FEFO——先到期先使用）。
blocks.en: The SOP must include this rule and set up a tracking system (such as FEFO - first expired, first out).

blocks.zh: 調配人員將一支商業包裝的注射用生理食鹽水帶入前室 clean side。應如何處理？
blocks.en: A compounder brings a commercially packaged vial of sterile saline for injection into the clean side of the anteroom. How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: ACD 的每日精確度評估記錄，如果某天超出廠商規格，應採取什麼步驟？
blocks.en: If the daily accuracy assessment record of an ACD shows a day when the result exceeded the manufacturer's specification, what steps should be taken?

blocks.zh: 收到一包批號 ABC-001 的 API，廠商標籤上沒有效期。設施應如何處理？可以使用多久？
blocks.en: A package of API with lot number ABC-001 is received, and the manufacturer's label has no expiration date. How should the facility handle it? How long can it be used?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 空氣 EM 動作水準：ISO 5 >1 cfu/m³；ISO 7 >10 cfu/m³；ISO 8 >100 cfu/m³
blocks.en: Air EM action levels: ISO 5 >1 cfu/m³; ISO 7 >10 cfu/m³; ISO 8 >100 cfu/m³

blocks.zh: 表面 EM 動作水準：ISO 5 >3 cfu；ISO 7 >5 cfu；ISO 8 >50 cfu
blocks.en: Surface EM action levels: ISO 5 >3 cfu; ISO 7 >5 cfu; ISO 8 >50 cfu

blocks.zh: Cat 3 EM 頻率：空氣採樣每月；表面採樣每週 + 每批次後（PEC）
blocks.en: Cat 3 EM frequency: air sampling monthly; surface sampling weekly + after each batch (PEC)

blocks.zh: 清潔順序：清潔（去污）→ 消毒（殺菌）→ 殺孢子劑（殺芽孢）；每步驟後必須達到接觸時間
blocks.en: Cleaning sequence: cleaning (remove soil) → disinfecting (kill microorganisms) → sporicidal agent (kill spores); the contact time must be achieved after each step

blocks.zh: 無效期原料：收貨日標記，不超過 1 年保存期；嚴禁使用「非藥用」或「非注射用」標示原料
blocks.en: Components without an expiration date: mark the date of receipt, storage period no more than 1 year; components labeled "not for pharmaceutical use" or "not for injection" are strictly prohibited
